# Stage 6 final development verification

## Result

All executable Stage 6 development exit conditions completed successfully on the final working tree. Stage 7 was not entered. `original-pi` and `gold-band` submodule revisions were not modified. The remaining mobile real-device matrix, independent Relay security review, and registered-client OAuth interoperability remain `FOLLOW_UP` as designed.

## Root-cause corrections completed during final external verification

- Replaced quadratic durable-event whole-BLOB rewrites with incremental `(session_id,event_seq)` SQLite rows and a 10,000-event regression.
- Made private Host bundle inventory ordering bytewise/canonical across Node and Java.
- Made Remote activation stop the old process before deleting the locator and starting the candidate, so readiness cannot bind to stale old-process state.
- Made immutable same-version directory reuse require a complete matching signed file inventory.
- Made rollback shell assignments syntactically valid, restored the previous locator from the recovered process, and independently reset activation markers.
- Upgraded legacy `ji-host-identity-v1` identity/device records without replacing Ed25519 keys or paired devices; explicit invalid algorithms remain rejected.
- Made Stage 6 consumer staging start clean and publish the complete Java module graph, eliminating stale timestamped SNAPSHOT artifacts that masked missing POM dependencies.

## Fixed-scale performance

Authorized Ubuntu container limits were exactly 2 vCPU, 4 GiB memory, and 4 GiB memory+swap. Terminal state was `exited`, exit 0, `OOM=false`.

- 1,000 Sessions
- 100,000 transcript items
- 10,000 durable replay events
- 2 Clients and 2 active Runs
- 16 Tool effects
- 2 GiB Artifact
- cold ready: 2 ms (limit 8,000 ms)
- list p95: 3 ms (limit 500 ms)
- search p95: 237 ms (limit 500 ms)
- Session first page p95: 2 ms (limit 750 ms)
- ACK p95: 15 ms (limit 150 ms)
- replay recovery: 46 ms (limit 2,000 ms)
- RSS: 1,103,204,352 bytes (limit 2 GiB)
- post-GC baseline/final: 4,681,560 / 4,679,088 bytes; growth -2,472 bytes (limit 5%)

Evidence: `external-release/performance-final2.log`.

## Release, package, migration, and rollback

- Linux Java 21 private Host archive: 504 regular files with path/mode/SHA-256 inventory and Ed25519 signature.
- Relay/Web/Ingress OCI archives retrieved; hardened smoke verified read-only rootfs, `no-new-privileges`, and `cap-drop ALL`.
- Isolated clean Host archive smoke passed.
- Real signed Host upgrade passed and created pre-migration backups; existing Host identity and paired device were migrated in place.
- A separately signed candidate with an intentionally failing launcher returned installer exit 6 and restored the final previous Host to ready state; activation markers were absent afterward.
- Clean complete Maven staging contains 1,465 files. External Gradle BOM consumer passed. Maven 3.9.11/Java 21 online and offline consumers both passed against that repository.
- Final bounded artifact set contains 1,475 files. CycloneDX 1.6 and SPDX 2.3 include 592 locked dependencies; provenance has 1,475 subjects; 1,475 artifacts received verified Ed25519 signatures.

Evidence is under `external-release/`, `local-consumer/`, and `final-release-3/`.

## Regression

- Stage 0–5 aggregate/split coverage passed, including 47 Web unit tests, production build, desktop/narrow/mobile Playwright, real Host, Host restart, standalone clean unpack, Stage 5 real two-browser topology, Ubuntu Compose, Remote topology, fixed TypeScript/Java ACP conformance, acpx 0.13.2, and Gold-Band 0.14.1 smoke.
- Final Stage 6 Java aggregate plus CLI and Remote tests passed: 111 tasks executed successfully.
- Generated contracts reproducible: 92 files.
- Stage gate contracts: 11/11.
- API baseline, ACP/HCP/Buf, module boundaries, naming, `git diff --check`, and submodule status passed.
- Real OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic smoke evidence was preserved; Google remains contract/faux.
- Gradle daemons stopped.
- Explicit JI-owned Stage 6 remote containers/images/directories were cleaned without global prune or changes to non-JI resources. The successfully installed final Host remains running by design.
